messages:
sam: Heads up — CI is red on the hosted integration suite for the third run in a row. Failures look auth/stream/tool-related. filing here before I start bisect.
ci-bot: build 5473 failed: step `integration/hosted-api` — see artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/5473
sam: failing test: `tests/integration/hosted_tool_call.test.ts::test_tool_call_with_streaming_auth` — assertion is a 401 from the Hosted API. intermittent 429s for other tests in same shard.
priya: oof. any obvious recent changes to auth headers or token rotation?
deploy-bot: rolled out auth header normalization at 2026-03-14T21:10:05Z to canary region (service-auth PR #4021).
anand: tagging in — looks like a token validation mismatch. I've seen similar where the hosted proxy started rejecting requests missing the `x-rw-session-v` header after normalization.
marta: can you paste the failing request/response (redact secrets)?
sam: snippet from test run logs:
```
Request: POST /v1/hosted/toolcall
Headers: { Authorization: "Bearer ***", "Content-Type": "application/json" }
Response: 401 Unauthorized
Body: { "error": "invalid_session", "reason": "missing x-rw-session-v" }
```
sam: also saw bursts of 429 on nearby tests in same shard, looks like rate-limiter spiking when auth fails and retries hammer the gateway.
leo: we should avoid rolling back the change unless necessary — can we add a compatibility shim in the test runner or patch the test service to set the header?
anand: short-term I can add a shim in the test fixture to set `x-rw-session-v: v1` for Hosted flows. longer-term we should make the gateway accept missing header for service tokens.
priya: +1 to shim. also request a bisect on the integration job to find the first green -> red commit window.
sam: please rerun shard 7 (contains the hosted integration tests) and run a bisect on the windows between builds 5458..5473. command I used earlier:
`./dev/ci rerun --job integration/hosted-api --shard 7 --range 5458-5473 --bisect`
ci-bot: queued rerun: build 5474 (shard 7) — link: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/5474
marta: I can take the shim in the test harness; will open a small PR to inject header for hosted-mode tests. assigning to @marta.
marta: quick note — test harness patch will set `x-rw-session-v: v1` only when `HOSTED_TEST=true` to avoid masking prod issues.
leo: nice. after shim lands and rerun confirms green we should create a follow-up task to update gateway acceptance and add a canary test for header-less service tokens.
anand: if 5474 still fails, please collect full HAR from the runner and the gateway debug logs (enable `AUTH_DEBUG=true` in the test job). that will make bisect useful.
priya: leaving a reminder to add the `rate_limit:retry` metric to the flaky tests dashboard — helps spot retries causing spike.
sam: thanks — @marta please ping when PR is up, I'll hold other bisect steps until we see rerun. :thumbsup:
marta: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/test-harness/merge_requests/129 — small header shim, tests patched locally. kicking rerun when CI finishes lint.
ci-bot: build 5475 queued: integration/hosted-api (shard 7) after MR pipeline
sam: thanks all — will follow the new run and open bisect if failures persist. :eyes:
